newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 98-99 INCOME TAXES TO BE CUT MORE - NIINISTO.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 98-99 INCOME TAXES TO BE CUT MORE - NIINISTO.

text.p: Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto said on Wednesday that Finnish personal income taxes would be cut further in 1998 and 1999.

"The 1997 income tax cuts are the biggest anyone can remember," Niinisto told a meeting of the Finnish taxpayers' association. He was referring to income tax cuts of about five billion markka decided by the government last autumn.

"We intend to conduct the same policy of lightening income taxes every year until the end of the election period," Niinisto said. The five-party government coalition's mandate runs until the next elections in March 1999.
The income tax cuts agreed for 1997 would be felt in taxpayers' wallets early in February and would "boost the domestic markets in a healthy way," Niinisto said.
